name: AR-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: R+23 district partisan lean in deep-red Arkansas
Incumbent Rick Crawford running with a large cash advantage
Democrat Terri Green has raised only $65k with minimal cash on hand
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~96%
model.rationale: Crawford holds a heavily Republican district, a dominant fundraising edge, and incumbency, while Green's campaign is minimally funded and no polls or expert ratings suggest competitiveness. Markets price this as a near-certain Republican hold.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Green within single digits or a major outside-spending influx would be the only sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Crawford seeks another term in a northeastern Arkansas district that leans Republican by roughly 23 points. He enters the general election with more than $1 million on hand after raising over $940,000, while Democrat Terri Green has raised about $65,000 and holds under $12,000. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot but has shown no measurable activity.

No public polls or expert ratings exist for this race, and prediction markets give the Democrat only about a 2% chance. The combination of the district's strong Republican lean, Crawford's incumbency, and the lopsided financial picture makes this a safe Republican seat, with the main question being the size of the winning margin rather than the outcome.
